An '''ambassador''' to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the middle of the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] in a crowded plaza within [[Kaas City]], the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. An investigation of the crime failed to yield any suspects, but an independent investigator tracked down and identified the culprit as a [[Unidentified rogue Imperial operative|rogue operative]] of the Empire, earning the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]]'s thanks.<ref name="Tracking a Shadow" />
